summary: Arrive AI Inc. filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, reporting a private placement in public equity (PIPE) under a Securities Purchase Agreement with one accredited investor. The issuer sold 384,615 shares and a common warrant for 384,615 shares at $0.65 per unit, raising $250,000 aggregate. The warrant is immediately exercisable at $0.70, expires October 5, 2031, and carries a 4.99% beneficial-ownership blocker (adjustable to 9.99%). A resale registration on Form S-3 is due within 20 days; proceeds fund general working capital. No placement agent fees. Watch resale registration timing and warrant overhang.
